canada.title: Halifax to look for cost saving options to bring forecasted property tax increase below CPI
canada.summary: Halifax council voted during Tuesday's budget committee meeting, for the city's top bureaucrat to search for ways to lower the forecasted average property tax increase from 6.8 per cent, to 5.4 per cent.
